$comment: Color values with nested var() fallbacks, shared by the tests of the ESLint plugin's no-raw-colors and the Stylelint config, so that both read them alike. custom: every channel comes from custom properties, each a var() whose fallback, if any, is var()s too, up to eight levels of fallbacks deep. raw: a fallback deep inside holds a literal channel, or the fallbacks nest nine levels deep, past what both follow.
custom: rgb(var(--a, var(--b), var(--c, var(--d))) / var(--e, var(--f, var(--g))))

rgba(var(--a, var(--b, var(--c, var(--d, var(--e, var(--f)))))), 0.5)
rgb(var(--v1, var(--v2, var(--v3, var(--v4, var(--v5, var(--v6, var(--v7, var(--v8, var(--v9))))))))))
